predecessors.name: Sultanate of Rum
predecessors.text: Sinop and the Black Sea coast eastward, in Rum's hands since the Seljuk capture of 1214

successors.name: Beylik of Candar (Isfendiyarids)
successors.text: Sinop, 'formerly ruled by the descendants of Mu'in al-Din Suleyman', annexed by Süleyman I of the Candar dynasty

ledger.x: 1277: the Pervâneid emirate at Sinop begins.
1322: Süleyman I of the Candar dynasty annexes Sinop.
1322: the Pervâneid emirate of Sinop ends (beyliks table 1277-1322); its land goes to the Candar state (beylik-of-isfendiyar), then seated at Kastamonu.

wars.name: Candarid annexation of Sinop
wars.outcome: Süleyman I of the Candars annexed Sinop and Safranbolu from the descendants of Mu'in al-Din Suleyman.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary for the Pervâneid emirate; its inland limit towards Kastamonu and its eastern limit towards Trebizond's coast are approximate.
